# KNS implementer kit (STP-KAS)

Share URL: https://stp-kas.github.io/kns-spec/
Repo: https://github.com/STP-KAS/kns-spec
Official KNS: https://kns-2.gitbook.io/kns-docs-1/inscriptions/overview
Wallets: https://kns-2.gitbook.io/kns-docs-1/supporting-wallet
Indexer API: https://kns-2.gitbook.io/kns-docs-1/kns-indexer-api
L1 indexer: https://github.com/supertypo/simply-kaspa-indexer
Letter: https://github.com/STP-KAS/kns-spec/blob/main/FOR-KNS.md

Two objects. Do not mix them.

- Inscription: protocol id kns, commit-reveal, uniqueness = official indexer FCFS. KasWare: buildScript type KNS. Kastle: commitReveal namespace kns (two popups). Reveal output 0 = protocol fee. Check POST /api/v1/domains/check first.
- Covenant: P2SH of KasName.sil, unrevealed deploys on https://covenants.kaspa.com/covenants. Not consensus uniqueness. KIP-20 covenant_id is from an outpoint, not the label.

Proven:

- kns.kas inscription reveal 223233acf8e5abea9291627a5edd859439c4553100c71309b86599f02414a532 payload {"op":"create","p":"domain","v":"kns"}
- bakery.kas / michelleobamaisaman.kas / trump.kas / opus.kas / opus.dei.kas unrevealed P2SH deploys (see proofs/proofs.json)

Implement: PROTOCOL.md, KASWARE.md, optional contracts/v1/KasName.sil compiled with silverc v1.0.0 (Ori, 3ed9733). No foreign readInputState (silverscript#234 still unmerged).
Never ask for a seed.
